title: FreedFi

prizes.title: Best Use or Extension of Fathom Protocol

description:
Empowering freelancers through talent-backed loans with FreedFi. 

FreedFi is changing the lending landscape by bringing access to capital with Skill Capital. Our lending infrastructure offers Talent-backed loans to skilled contractors. Leveraging decentralized finance strategies and Trust Credentials, we bring transparency, accountability, and real-time credit score reputation (Erc1155 + Analytics) to the lending cycle.

Join us as we shape the future of lending with a trustless, on-chain solution for DAOs, communities, member organizations and more!

Unique Value Proposition:
Loans for skilled freelancers backed by talent alone.
Zero Interest Loans 
No Collateral Needed 

Problems We're Solving:
Freelancers face overwhelming difficulties in obtaining loans due to the absence of a steady work history, which hinders their access to traditional lending options. This hinders dreams of sustainable living, home ownership, car leasing and more.

Smart Contracts:
GetaLoan.sol https://github.com/captainahab0x/freedfi/blob/main/contracts/src/GetALoan.sol
- Borrowers request, are approved, and payback loans
- Investors approve loans and receive payback
- FreedFi Pool funds the loan and issues Trust Credentials(ERC1155+Analytics)

PoolControler.sol
https://github.com/captainahab0x/freedfi/blob/main/contracts/src/PoolController.sol
- Allows FreedFi DeFi Pool to manage investor funds trasparently
- Rewards Investors for reviewing & approving freelancer loan requestws

TrustCredential.sol
https://github.com/captainahab0x/freedfi/tree/main/contracts/src/trustcredentials
- TrustCredentials are issued after a loan is repaid 
- Mathematical equation determins the reliability score by calculating date of return compared to date due.
- Investors get TrustCredential to redeem their reward for choosing which loans to fund
- Borrowers get TrustCredentals that attest to their reliability and credit score

Review Goldfinch.Finance whitepaper for one of our inspirations.
